BBPS, or Bharat Bill Payment System, is an electronic bill payment and settlement system in India. It allows consumers to make bill payments online for various services such as electricity, water, gas, telephone, DTH, broadband, mobile recharge, insurance premiums, school/college fees, credit card bills, personal loans, home loans, vehicle loans, and other recurring payments. BBPS is operated by NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India), which is an umbrella organization for all retail payment systems in India.

BHIM, or Bharat Interface for Money, is a Unified Payments Interface (UPI) platform developed by National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). UPI is a real-time payment system that enables users to transfer funds directly from their bank account to the recipient's account using a virtual payment address or a mobile number. BHIM allows users to create a virtual payment address linked to their bank account, and use this virtual payment address to receive payments from other users.
